Privacy

Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 18, 2026

SaldoPilot is a personal finance app for tracking income, expenses, due dates, categories, recurring transactions, reminders, backups, and local financial summaries.

Data stored by the app

SaldoPilot stores the financial data you enter, including transaction titles, amounts, dates, payment status, categories, recurrence rules, notes, settings, language choice, and notification preferences. SaldoPilot does not require a SaldoPilot account.

The app may use Apple's private iCloud and CloudKit services when enabled for the app and your Apple ID. iCloud data is handled by Apple under your iCloud account.

Collection and tracking

SaldoPilot does not sell your data, use third-party advertising or tracking SDKs, or track you across apps and websites owned by other companies. It does not connect to bank accounts or process payments.

AI features

AI-style summaries and questions in the current app version are generated locally from your transactions. Transaction data is not sent to an external AI service. Suggestions are informational and do not automatically create, modify, delete, submit, or pay transactions.

Notifications

SaldoPilot can schedule local notifications for due dates and pending income. Notification content is generated on your device.

Import, export, and reports

JSON, CSV, and PDF files are created locally when you choose to import, export, share, save, or print. These files may contain sensitive financial information. You control where they are stored and shared.

Contact

For questions about this policy, visit the SaldoPilot support page. Do not include private financial information in a public support request.
